reason: I only have Saturdays, so $59 a month works out to about $15 a visit, and the zoo is free. I'm not paying a membership for a place I haven't seen.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth, and a shared play village full of toys worries me. I also only get about four Saturdays a month, so a membership doesn't pay off for me.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, visible cleaning routine (toys sanitized between sessions, shoes-off rule), plus a cheaper weekend-only or 4-visit pass so I'm not paying for days I can't use.
